channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dominican Republic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dominican Republic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Dominican Republic
item.description:
“We're taking it everywhere. Yes sir, I'm gonna bring it to Santiago, Santo Domingo, Casa de Campo, La Romana... Great that Dominicans all around the world get to celebrate this moment.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Dominican Republic, Jun 14, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Madison Square Garden, Dominican Republic
item.description:
Knicks’ Karl-Anthony Towns on what it means to help the Knicks return to the Finals:

“It means a lot for my mother. When she emigrated from [the Dominican Republic] to New York, she saw Madison Square Garden for the first time and saw the energy the city has for Madison Square Garden and the Knicks. My mom, even to the day she passed, wasn’t big on the NBA rules, but one thing she did know was that only the best of the best perform and play at Madison Square Garden. To be able to have this moment in Knicks history where we’re back here, where New York has been hungry to be back in this Finals, it means a lot. It means a lot to me, my loved ones, to be part of the Knicks history that’s doing this.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Madison Square Garden, Dominican Republic, Jun 2, 2026. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Felipe Lopez on Dominican Republic
item.description:
“She was such an amazing lady. She was wonderful. She is what you would call a true Dominican mom, with all the whistles,”

Felipe Lopez on Dominican Republic, Oct 16, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Dominican Republic
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns told The Post.

“And for my Dominican culture and my family, it hit me in a way that it’s like, these cookouts that I haven’t been around for, for a decade-plus, I have a chance to make them now.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Dominican Republic, Oct 16, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Dominican Republic
item.description:
“When you look at an offensive player, particularly a big, the skill set that he has, I think we all saw, to win the 3-point contest and stuff like that, there’s nothing he can’t do offensively. He has continued to get better I think. He had some injuries to deal with. I watched him play in FIBA [the World Cup, for the Dominican Republic], he played really well there. He’s really, really gifted.”

Tom Thibodeau on Dominican Republic, Oct 13, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Dominican Republic
item.description:
After the match, he expressed his feelings of amazement.

“It’s amazing. I’ve never been here before. I had been telling everyone how eager I was to come out here. I’m super excited to be here; the fans were absolutely incredible to us. One of my best friends is heavily involved in Filipino culture. I’m incredibly proud to be Dominican, to be here with a win, and also to connect with all the fans here in the Philippines,”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Dominican Republic, Aug 25, 2023. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Al Horford on Dominican Republic
item.description:
“I got a chance to spend time with him at Basketball Without Borders [in the Dominican Republic]. He’s always one of those guys pushing for the NBA to be more involved in Latin America. He wants to make sure the game will grow in our countries over there. That is always what I have gotten from him. He doesn’t only talk about it. He goes down there, does work and makes a difference.”

Al Horford on Dominican Republic, Mar 26, 2019. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Maurice Baker on Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic
item.description:
“It’s a sacrifice league. The money is not that great, but it pays the bills. During the summer, I try to make that money up that I didn’t make playing in the D-League by playing in the Dominican Republic or Puerto Rico. It works for me,”

Maurice Baker on Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, Jan 8, 2016. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Francisco Garcia on Dominican Republic
item.description:
The Rockets forward leaves the National Team after 11 years.

“I’ve played my last games with Dominican NT. I am proud of having played 11 years with the national team”

Francisco Garcia on Dominican Republic, Sep 11, 2014. Source: Sportando.

item.title: John Calipari on Dominican Republic
item.description:
“Well, I’m officially retiring after this game … from the Dominican Republic. I’m going to help them, consult and do those things, but I don’t think I’m going to be coaching them.”

John Calipari on Dominican Republic, Jul 13, 2012. Source: Official Site of John Calipari.

item.title: Charlie Villanueva on Dominican Republic
item.description:
Villanueva texted when asked about overseas options.

“If I play there in Dominican Republic, it won’t be for the pay, but it will be for my people. They are passionate about the game of basketball. “One hundred percent, basketball is my passion. If the lockout continues, it won’t stop me from doing what I love to do. Overseas is a possibility for sure.”

Charlie Villanueva on Dominican Republic, Jul 19, 2011. Source: HoopsHype.
